Aur jo log imaan laye dil se aur shar'a ke mutabiq a'maal kiye badan se, yani zahir-o-batin dono Allah ki taraf jhuka diye. Aur uss Wahi-e-Ilahi ko bhi maan liya jo maujooda Aakhir-uz-Zaman Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utari gayi hai. Aur jo filwaqai Rabb ki taraf se hi hai aur jo sarasar haq-o-sadaqat hi hai. Unki buraiyan barbad hain aur unke haal ki islah ka zimmedar khud Allah hai. Jab kuffar se maidan-e-jihad mein amna samna ho jaye yahan imandaron ko jangi ahkaam diye jate hain ke jab kafiron se mudbher ho jaye dasti ladai shuru ho jaye to un ki gardanein urao, talwarein chala kar gardan dhar se ura do. Phir jab dekho ke dushman hara us ke aadmi kafi kat chuke to baqi manda ko mazboot qaid-o-band ke sath muqayyad kar lo jab ladai khatam ho chuke ma'arka pura ho jaye to phir tumhein ikhtiyar hai ke qaidiyon ko bator-e-ehsan baghair kuch liye hi chor do aur yeh bhi ikhtiyar hai ke un se tawan-e-jang wasool karo phir choro. Ba-zahir maloom hota hai ke Badr ke ghazwe ke baad yeh aayat utri hai kyunke Badr ke ma'arke mein zyada tar mukhalifeen ko qaid karne aur qaid karne ki kami karne mein musalmanon par itaab kiya gaya tha aur farmaya tha aayat (Maa kaana linabiyyin ay-yakuna lahu asraa hatta yuskhina fil-ard, turiduna aradad-dunya, wallahu yuridul-akhirah, wallahu Azizun Hakim) (Surah Al-Anfal: 67), Nabi ko laiq na tha ke us ke paas qaidi hon jab tak ke ek martaba jee khol kar mukhalifeen mein maut ki garam bazari na ho le kya tum dunyawi asbab ki chahat mein ho? Allah ka irada to aakhirat ka hai aur Allah Aziz-o-Hakim hai. Agar pehle hi se Allah ka likha hua na hota to jo tum ne liya us ki babat tumhein bara azab hota. Ba'az ulama ka qaul hai ke yeh ikhtiyar mansookh hai aur yeh aayat nasikh hai aayat (Fa-idhan-salakhal-ashhurul-hurumu faqtulul-mushrikina haithu wajattumuhum wa khudhuhum wahsuruhum waq'udu lahum kulla marsad, fa-in taabu wa aqamus-salata wa aatuz-zakata fakhallu sabeelahum, innallaha Ghafurur-Rahim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5), yani hurmat wale mahine jab guzar jayen to mushrikon ko jahan pao wahin qatl karo. Lekin aksar ulama ka farman hai ke mansookh nahin. Ab ba'az to kehte hain qatl kar dalne ka bhi ikhtiyar hai is ki daleel yeh hai ke Badr ke qaidiyon mein se Nazr bin Harith aur Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qatl kara diya tha aur yeh bhi is ki daleel hai ke Thumama bin Athal ne jab ke woh aseeri halat mein the aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se pucha tha ke kaho Thumama kya khayal hai? To unhon ne kaha agar aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) qatl karenge to ek khoon wale ko qatl karenge aur agar aap ehsan rakhenge to ek shukr guzar par ehsan rakhenge aur agar maal talab karte hain to jo aap mangenge mil jayega. Hazrat Imam Shafi'i ek chauthi baat ka bhi ikhtiyar batate hain yani qatl, ehsan, badle ka aur ghulam bana kar rakh lene ka. Is masle ki tafseel ki jagah faru'i masail ki kitabein hain. Aur hum ne bhi Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Kitab-ul-Ahkaam mein is ke dalail bayan kar diye hain. Phir farmata hai yahan tak ke ladai apne hathiyar rakh de yani baqol Mujahid Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) nazil ho jayen.

Mumkin hai Hazrat Mujahid ki nazrein is hadith par hon jis mein hai meri ummat hamesha haq ke sath zahir rahegi yahan tak ke un ka aakhri shakhs Dajjal se lare ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Nasai mein hai ke Hazrat Salma bin Nufail khidmat-e-Nabawi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein hazir hue aur arz karne lage main ne ghoron ko chor diya aur hathiyar alag kar diye aur larai ne apne hathiyar rakh diye aur main ne keh diya ke ab larai hai hi nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ab larai aa gayi, meri ummat mein se ek jamaat hamesha logon par zahir rahegi jin logon ke dilon mein terh aa jaye gi yeh un se larenge aur Allah Ta'ala unhein un se roziyan de ga yahan tak ke Allah ka Amr-e-Ilahi aa jaye aur woh isi halat par honge mominon ki zameen Sham mein hai. Ghoron ki ayal mein Qayamat tak ke liye Allah ne khair rakh di hai yeh hadith Imam Baghawi ne bhi warid ki hai aur Hafiz Abu Ya'la Mosuli ne bhi, is se bhi is ki ta'eed hoti hai ke jo log is ayat ko mansookh nahin batate goya ke yeh hukm mashroo hai jab tak larai baqi rahe aur is hadith ne bataya ke larai Qayamat tak baqi rahegi yeh ayat misl is ayat ke hai ayat (وَقَاتِلُوْهُمْ حَتّٰي لَا تَكُوْنَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّيَكُوْنَ الدِّيْنُ كُلُّهٗ لِلّٰهِ ۚ فَاِنِ انْتَهَـوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ) (Surah Al-Anfal: 39), yani un se larte raho jab tak ke fitna baqi hai aur jab tak ke deen Allah hi ke liye na ho jaye. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain larai ke hathiyar rakh dene se murad shirk ka baqi na rehna hai aur ba'az se marwi hai ke murad yeh hai ke mushrikeen apne shirk se tauba kar lein aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh apni koshishein Allah ki ita'at mein sarf karne lag jayen phir farmata hai ke agar Allah chahta to aap hi kuffar ko barbad kar deta apne paas se un par azab bhej deta lekin woh to yeh chahta hai ke tumhein azma le isi liye jihad ke ahkaam jari farmaye hain Surah Al-Imran aur Bara'at mein bhi isi mazmoon ko bayan kiya hai. Al-Imran mein hai ayat (اَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ اَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ جٰهَدُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ الصّٰبِرِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Imran: 142), kya tumhara yeh guman hai ke baghair is baat ke ke Allah jaan le ke tum mein se mujahid kaun hain aur tum mein se sabr karne wale kaun hain tum Jannat mein chale jaoge? Surah Bara'at mein hai ayat (قَاتِلُوْهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِاَيْدِيْكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُوْرَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 14).

(At-Tawbah: 14) In se jihad karo, Allah tumhare hathon inhe azab karega aur tumhein un par nusrat ata farmayega aur iman walon ke seene shifa wale kar dega aur apne dilon ke walwale nikalne ka inhe mauqa dega aur jis ki chahega tauba qabool farmayega, Allah bada Aleem-o-Hakeem hai. Ab chunke yeh bhi tha ke jihad mein momin bhi shaheed hon, is liye farmata hai ke shaheedon ke aamal akarat nahin jayenge balkeh bahut badha chadha kar sawab inhe diye jayenge. Baaz ko toh Qayamat tak ke sawab milenge. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke shaheed ko chhe inamaat hasil hote hain: us ke khoon ka pehla qatra zameen par girte hi us ke kul gunah maaf ho jate hain. Use us ka jannat ka makan dikha diya jata hai aur nihayat khubsurat badi badi aankhon wali hooron se us ka nikah kara diya jata hai, woh badi ghabrahat se aman mein rehta hai, woh azab-e-qabr se bacha liya jata hai, use iman ke zevar se aarasta kar diya jata hai. Ek aur hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke us ke sar par waqar ka taj rakha jata hai, jo dur-o-yaqoot ka jadao hota hai jis mein ka ek yaqoot tamam duniya aur us ki tamam cheezon se garan-baha hai. Use behtar hoor-e-ain milti hain aur apne khandan ke sattar shakhson ke bare mein us ki shafa'at qabool ki jati hai. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, siwaye qarz ke shaheedon ke sab gunah bakhash diye jate hain. Shaheedon ke fazail ki aur bhi bahut hadithein hain. Phir farmata hai inhe Allah jannat ki rah samjha dega. Jaise yeh aayat: (Innal-lazeena amanu wa amilus-salihati yahdeehim rabbuhum bi-eemani-him, tajree min tahtihimul-anhari fee jannatin-na'eem) (10. Yunus: 9), yani jo log iman laye aur jinhon ne nek kaam kiye un ke iman ke ba'is un ka Rab inhe un jannaton ki taraf rahbari karega jo na'imaton se pur hain aur jin ke chappe chappe mein chashme beh rahe hain. Allah un ke haal aur un ke kaam sanwar dega aur jin jannaton se inhe pehle hi aagah kar chuka hai aur jin ki taraf un ki rahbari kar chuka hai, aakhir unhi mein inhe pahunchayega. Yani har shakhs apne makan aur apni jagah ko jannat mein is tarah pehchan lega jaise duniya mein pehchan liya karta tha. Inhe kisi se puchne ki zaroorat na padegi, yeh maloom hoga goya shuru paidaish se yahin muqeem hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke jis insan ke sath us ke aamal ka muhafiz jo farishta tha, wahi us ke aage aage chalega, jab yeh apni jagah pahunchega toh az-khud pehchan lega ke meri jagah yahi hai. Yunhi phir apni zameen mein sair karta hua jab sab dekh chuke ga tab farishta hat jayega aur yeh apni lazzaton mein mashghool ho jayega.

Sahih Bukhari ki marfoo hadith mein hai jab momin aag se chhoot jayenge toh jannat, dozakh ke darmiyan ek pul par rok liye jayenge aur aapas mein ek dusre par jo mazalim thay un ke badle utaar liye jayenge jab bilkul paak saaf ho jayenge toh jannat mein jaane ki ijazat mil jayegi. Qasam Allah ki jis tarah tum mein se har ek shakhs apne dunyawi ghar ki raah jaanta hai aur ghar ko pehchanta hai us se bahut zyada woh log apni manzil aur apni jagah se waqif honge. Phir farmata hai iman walo agar tum Allah ki madad karoge toh woh tumhari madad karega aur tumhare qadam mazboot kar dega, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Walyansurannallahu man yansuruhu innallaha laqawiyyun aziz) (22-Al-Hajj: 40) Allah zaroor us ki madad karega jo Allah ki madad karega is liye ke jaisa amal hota hai usi jins ki jaza hoti hai aur woh tumhare qadam bhi mazboot kar dega. Hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi ikhtiyar wale ke samne ek aise haajat mand ki haajat pahunchaye jo khud wahan na pahunch sakta ho toh qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala pul-e-sirat par us ke qadam mazbooti se jama dega. Phir farmata hai kafiron ka haal bilkul bar-aks hai yeh qadam qadam par thhokrein khayenge. Hadith mein hai dinar dirham aur kapre latte ka banda thhokar kha gaya woh barbad hua aur halak hua woh agar bimar pad jaye toh Allah kare use shifa bhi na ho. Aise logon ke nek aamal bhi akaarat hain is liye ke yeh Quran-o-Hadith se na-khush hain na is ki izzat-o-azmat un ke dilon mein na un ka qasd-o-tasleem ka irada. Pas un ke jo kuch achhe kaam thay Allah ne unhein bhi gharat kar diya.

Mumkin hai Hazrat Mujahid ki nazrein is hadith par hon jis mein hai meri ummat hamesha haq ke sath zahir rahegi yahan tak ke un ka aakhri shakhs Dajjal se lare ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Nasai mein hai ke Hazrat Salma bin Nufail khidmat-e-Nabawi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein hazir hue aur arz karne lage main ne ghoron ko chor diya aur hathiyar alag kar diye aur larai ne apne hathiyar rakh diye aur main ne keh diya ke ab larai hai hi nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ab larai aa gayi, meri ummat mein se ek jamaat hamesha logon par zahir rahegi jin logon ke dilon mein terh aa jaye gi yeh un se larenge aur Allah Ta'ala unhein un se roziyan de ga yahan tak ke Allah ka Amr-e-Ilahi aa jaye aur woh isi halat par honge mominon ki zameen Sham mein hai. Ghoron ki ayal mein Qayamat tak ke liye Allah ne khair rakh di hai yeh hadith Imam Baghawi ne bhi warid ki hai aur Hafiz Abu Ya'la Mosuli ne bhi, is se bhi is ki ta'eed hoti hai ke jo log is ayat ko mansookh nahin batate goya ke yeh hukm mashroo hai jab tak larai baqi rahe aur is hadith ne bataya ke larai Qayamat tak baqi rahegi yeh ayat misl is ayat ke hai ayat (وَقَاتِلُوْهُمْ حَتّٰي لَا تَكُوْنَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّيَكُوْنَ الدِّيْنُ كُلُّهٗ لِلّٰهِ ۚ فَاِنِ انْتَهَـوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ) (Surah Al-Anfal: 39), yani un se larte raho jab tak ke fitna baqi hai aur jab tak ke deen Allah hi ke liye na ho jaye. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain larai ke hathiyar rakh dene se murad shirk ka baqi na rehna hai aur ba'az se marwi hai ke murad yeh hai ke mushrikeen apne shirk se tauba kar lein aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh apni koshishein Allah ki ita'at mein sarf karne lag jayen phir farmata hai ke agar Allah chahta to aap hi kuffar ko barbad kar deta apne paas se un par azab bhej deta lekin woh to yeh chahta hai ke tumhein azma le isi liye jihad ke ahkaam jari farmaye hain Surah Al-Imran aur Bara'at mein bhi isi mazmoon ko bayan kiya hai. Al-Imran mein hai ayat (اَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ اَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ جٰهَدُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ الصّٰبِرِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Imran: 142), kya tumhara yeh guman hai ke baghair is baat ke ke Allah jaan le ke tum mein se mujahid kaun hain aur tum mein se sabr karne wale kaun hain tum Jannat mein chale jaoge? Surah Bara'at mein hai ayat (قَاتِلُوْهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِاَيْدِيْكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُوْرَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 14).

(At-Tawbah: 14) In se jihad karo, Allah tumhare hathon inhe azab karega aur tumhein un par nusrat ata farmayega aur iman walon ke seene shifa wale kar dega aur apne dilon ke walwale nikalne ka inhe mauqa dega aur jis ki chahega tauba qabool farmayega, Allah bada Aleem-o-Hakeem hai. Ab chunke yeh bhi tha ke jihad mein momin bhi shaheed hon, is liye farmata hai ke shaheedon ke aamal akarat nahin jayenge balkeh bahut badha chadha kar sawab inhe diye jayenge. Baaz ko toh Qayamat tak ke sawab milenge. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke shaheed ko chhe inamaat hasil hote hain: us ke khoon ka pehla qatra zameen par girte hi us ke kul gunah maaf ho jate hain. Use us ka jannat ka makan dikha diya jata hai aur nihayat khubsurat badi badi aankhon wali hooron se us ka nikah kara diya jata hai, woh badi ghabrahat se aman mein rehta hai, woh azab-e-qabr se bacha liya jata hai, use iman ke zevar se aarasta kar diya jata hai. Ek aur hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke us ke sar par waqar ka taj rakha jata hai, jo dur-o-yaqoot ka jadao hota hai jis mein ka ek yaqoot tamam duniya aur us ki tamam cheezon se garan-baha hai. Use behtar hoor-e-ain milti hain aur apne khandan ke sattar shakhson ke bare mein us ki shafa'at qabool ki jati hai. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, siwaye qarz ke shaheedon ke sab gunah bakhash diye jate hain. Shaheedon ke fazail ki aur bhi bahut hadithein hain. Phir farmata hai inhe Allah jannat ki rah samjha dega. Jaise yeh aayat: (Innal-lazeena amanu wa amilus-salihati yahdeehim rabbuhum bi-eemani-him, tajree min tahtihimul-anhari fee jannatin-na'eem) (10. Yunus: 9), yani jo log iman laye aur jinhon ne nek kaam kiye un ke iman ke ba'is un ka Rab inhe un jannaton ki taraf rahbari karega jo na'imaton se pur hain aur jin ke chappe chappe mein chashme beh rahe hain. Allah un ke haal aur un ke kaam sanwar dega aur jin jannaton se inhe pehle hi aagah kar chuka hai aur jin ki taraf un ki rahbari kar chuka hai, aakhir unhi mein inhe pahunchayega. Yani har shakhs apne makan aur apni jagah ko jannat mein is tarah pehchan lega jaise duniya mein pehchan liya karta tha. Inhe kisi se puchne ki zaroorat na padegi, yeh maloom hoga goya shuru paidaish se yahin muqeem hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke jis insan ke sath us ke aamal ka muhafiz jo farishta tha, wahi us ke aage aage chalega, jab yeh apni jagah pahunchega toh az-khud pehchan lega ke meri jagah yahi hai. Yunhi phir apni zameen mein sair karta hua jab sab dekh chuke ga tab farishta hat jayega aur yeh apni lazzaton mein mashghool ho jayega.

Sahih Bukhari ki marfoo hadith mein hai jab momin aag se chhoot jayenge toh jannat, dozakh ke darmiyan ek pul par rok liye jayenge aur aapas mein ek dusre par jo mazalim thay un ke badle utaar liye jayenge jab bilkul paak saaf ho jayenge toh jannat mein jaane ki ijazat mil jayegi. Qasam Allah ki jis tarah tum mein se har ek shakhs apne dunyawi ghar ki raah jaanta hai aur ghar ko pehchanta hai us se bahut zyada woh log apni manzil aur apni jagah se waqif honge. Phir farmata hai iman walo agar tum Allah ki madad karoge toh woh tumhari madad karega aur tumhare qadam mazboot kar dega, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Walyansurannallahu man yansuruhu innallaha laqawiyyun aziz) (22-Al-Hajj: 40) Allah zaroor us ki madad karega jo Allah ki madad karega is liye ke jaisa amal hota hai usi jins ki jaza hoti hai aur woh tumhare qadam bhi mazboot kar dega. Hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi ikhtiyar wale ke samne ek aise haajat mand ki haajat pahunchaye jo khud wahan na pahunch sakta ho toh qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala pul-e-sirat par us ke qadam mazbooti se jama dega. Phir farmata hai kafiron ka haal bilkul bar-aks hai yeh qadam qadam par thhokrein khayenge. Hadith mein hai dinar dirham aur kapre latte ka banda thhokar kha gaya woh barbad hua aur halak hua woh agar bimar pad jaye toh Allah kare use shifa bhi na ho. Aise logon ke nek aamal bhi akaarat hain is liye ke yeh Quran-o-Hadith se na-khush hain na is ki izzat-o-azmat un ke dilon mein na un ka qasd-o-tasleem ka irada. Pas un ke jo kuch achhe kaam thay Allah ne unhein bhi gharat kar diya.

Tamam shehron se pyara shehar. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke in logon ne jo Allah ka shareek thehrate hain aur uske Rasool ko jhutla rahe hain zameen ki sair nahin ki? Jo yeh maloom kar lete hain aur apni aankhon dekh lete hain ke un se agle jo un jaise thay un ke anjam kya hue? Kis tarah woh takht-o-taraj kar diye gaye aur un mein se sirf Islam-o-Imaan wale hi nijat pa sake kafiron ke liye isi tarah ke azab aaya karte hain. Phir bayan farmata hai musalmanon ka khud Allah wali hai aur kuffar be-wali hain. Isi liye Uhud wale din mushrikeen ke sardar Abu Sufyan (Sakhr) bin Harb ne fakhr ke sath jab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dono khulafa ki nisbat sawal kiya aur koi jawab na paya to kehne laga ke yeh sab halak ho gaye. Phir use Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne jawab diya aur farmaya jin ki zindagi tujhe khar ki tarah khatakti hai Allah ne un sab ko apne fazl se zinda hi rakha hai. Abu Sufyan kehne laga suno yeh din Badr ke badle ka din hai aur ladai to misl dolon ke hai kabhi koi upar kabhi koi upar. Tum apne maqtooleen mein ba'az aise bhi paoge jin ke naak kaan waghera unke marne ke baad kaat liye gaye hain main ne aisa hukum nahin diya lekin mujhe kuch bura bhi nahin laga. Phir us ne rajaz ke ashaar fakhriya parhne shuru kiye kehne laga (A'al Hubal, A'al Hubal). Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum ise jawab kyun nahin dete? Sahaba ne pucha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya jawab dein? Farmaya kaho (Allah-u-A'ala wa Ajal) yani woh kehta tha Hubal but ka bol bala ho jis ke jawab mein kaha gaya sab se zyada bulandi wala aur sab se zyada izzat-o-karam wala Allah hi hai. Abu Sufyan ne phir kaha (Lanal Uzza wa la Uzza lakum) hamara Uzza (but) hai aur tumhara nahin. Is ke jawab mein ba-farman-e-Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaha gaya (Allah-u-Maulana wa la Maula lakum) Allah hamara Maula hai aur tumhara Maula koi nahin. Phir Janab-e-Bari khabar dete hain ke imandar Qayamat ke din jannat-nasheen honge aur kufr karne wale duniya mein to khwah kuch yunhi sa nafa utha lein lekin un ka asli thikana Jahannam hai. Duniya mein un ki zindagi ka maqsad sirf khana peena aur pet bharna hai ise yeh log misl janwaron ke pura kar rahe hain jis tarah woh idhar udhar munh maar kar geela sookha pet mein bharne ka hi irada rakhta hai isi tarah yeh hai ke halal haram ki use kuch tameez nahin, pet bharna maqsood hai, Hadith shareef mein hai momin ek aant mein khata hai aur kafir saat aanton mein, jaza wale din apne is kufr ki padash mein un ke liye Jahannam ki gonagon sazayein hain. Phir kuffar-e-Makkah ko dhamkata hai aur apne azabon se darata hai ke dekho jin bastiyon wale tum se bahut zyada taqat-o-quwwat wale thay un ko hum ne nabiyon ko jhutlane aur hamare ahkaam ki khilaf warzi karne ki wajah se tehas nehas kar diya tum jo un se kamzor aur kam taqat ho is Rasool ko jhutlate aur eizayein pahunchate ho jo Khatam-ul-Anbiya aur Sayyid-ur-Rusul hain samajh lo ke tumhara anjam kya hoga?

Mana ke is Nabi-e-Rahmat ke mubarak wajood ki wajah se agar dunyawi azab tum par bhi na aaye to ukhrawi zabardast azab to tum se door nahin ho sakte? Jab Ahl-e-Makkah ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nikala aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ghar mein aakar apne aap ko chupaya us waqt Makkah ki taraf tawajjah ki aur farmane lage, "Ae Makkah! Tu tamam shehron se zyada Allah ko pyara hai aur isi tarah mujhe bhi tamam shehron se zyada pyara tu hai, agar mushrikeen mujhe tujh mein se na nikalte to main hargiz na nikalta." Isi liye Uhud wale din mushrikeen ke sardar Abu Sufyan (Sakhr) bin Harb ne fakhr ke sath jab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dono khulafa ki nisbat sawal kiya aur koi jawab na paya to kehne laga ke yeh sab halak ho gaye. Phir use Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne jawab diya aur farmaya jin ki zindagi tujhe khar ki tarah khatakti hai Allah ne un sab ko apne fazl se zinda hi rakha hai. Abu Sufyan kehne laga suno yeh din Badr ke badle ka din hai aur ladai to misl dolon ke hai kabhi koi upar kabhi koi upar. Tum apne maqtooleen mein ba'az aise bhi paoge jin ke naak kaan waghera unke marne ke baad kaat liye gaye hain main ne aisa hukum nahin diya lekin mujhe kuch bura bhi nahin laga. Phir us ne rajaz ke ashaar fakhriya parhne shuru kiye kehne laga (A'al Hubal, A'al Hubal). Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum ise jawab kyun nahin dete? Sahaba ne pucha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya jawab dein? Farmaya kaho (Allah-u-A'ala wa Ajal) yani woh kehta tha Hubal but ka bol bala ho jis ke jawab mein kaha gaya sab se zyada bulandi wala aur sab se zyada izzat-o-karam wala Allah hi hai. Abu Sufyan ne phir kaha (Lanal Uzza wa la Uzza lakum) hamara Uzza (but) hai aur tumhara nahin. Is ke jawab mein ba-farman-e-Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaha gaya (Allah-u-Maulana wa la Maula lakum) Allah hamara Maula hai aur tumhara Maula koi nahin. Phir Janab-e-Bari khabar dete hain ke imandar Qayamat ke din jannat-nasheen honge aur kufr karne wale duniya mein to khwah kuch yunhi sa nafa utha lein lekin un ka asli thikana Jahannam hai. Duniya mein un ki zindagi ka maqsad sirf khana peena aur pet bharna hai ise yeh log misl janwaron ke pura kar rahe hain jis tarah woh idhar udhar munh maar kar geela sookha pet mein bharne ka hi irada rakhta hai isi tarah yeh hai ke halal haram ki use kuch tameez nahin, pet bharna maqsood hai, Hadith shareef mein hai momin ek aant mein khata hai aur kafir saat aanton mein, jaza wale din apne is kufr ki padash mein un ke liye Jahannam ki gonagon sazayein hain. Phir kuffar-e-Makkah ko dhamkata hai aur apne azabon se darata hai ke dekho jin bastiyon wale tum se bahut zyada taqat-o-quwwat wale thay un ko hum ne nabiyon ko jhutlane aur hamare ahkaam ki khilaf warzi karne ki wajah se tehas nehas kar diya tum jo un se kamzor aur kam taqat ho is Rasool ko jhutlate aur eizayein pahunchate ho jo Khatam-ul-Anbiya aur Sayyid-ur-Rusul hain samajh lo ke tumhara anjam kya hoga?

Mana ke is Nabi-e-Rahmat ke mubarak wajood ki wajah se agar dunyawi azab tum par bhi na aaye to ukhrawi zabardast azab to tum se door nahin ho sakte? Jab Ahl-e-Makkah ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nikala aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ghar mein aakar apne aap ko chupaya us waqt Makkah ki taraf tawajjah ki aur farmane lage, "Ae Makkah! Tu tamam shehron se zyada Allah ko pyara hai aur isi tarah mujhe bhi tamam shehron se zyada pyara tu hai, agar mushrikeen mujhe tujh mein se na nikalte to main hargiz na nikalta." Pas tamam had se guzar jaane walon mein sab se bada had se guzar jaane wala woh hai jo Allah Ta'ala ki hadon se aage nikal jaye ya Haram-e-Ilahi mein kisi qatil ke siwa kisi aur ko qatl kare ya jahiliyat ke ta'assub ki bina par qatl kare, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par yeh aayat utari.

Doodh, pani aur shehad ke samundar. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo shakhs Deen-e-Allah mein yaqeen ke darje tak pahunch chuka ho, jise baseerat hasil ho chuki ho, fitrat-e-sahiha ke sath sath hidayat-o-ilm bhi ho, woh aur woh shakhs jo bad-a'amaliyon ko nek-kariyan samajh raha ho, jo apni khwahish-e-nafs ke peeche pada hua ho, yeh dono barabar nahin ho sakte. Jaise farman hai aayat: (Afamay ya'lamu annama unzila ilaika mir-rabbikal haqqu kamanhua a'ma, innama yatadhakkaru ulul-albab) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 19). Ya'ni yeh nahin ho sakta ke Allah ki wahi ko haq manne wala aur ek andha barabar ho jaye. Aur irshad hai aayat: (La yastawi as-habun-nari wa as-habul-jannah, as-habul-jannati humul-fa'izun) (59. Al-Hashr: 20). Ya'ni jahannami aur jannati barabar nahin ho sakte, jannati kamyab aur murad ko pahunche hue hain. Phir jannat ke aur ausaf bayan farmata hai ke is mein pani ke chashme hain jo kabhi bigadta nahin, mutaghayyar nahin hota, sadta nahin, na badbu paida hoti hai, bahut saaf moti jaisa hai, koi gadla-pan nahin, koda-karkat nahin. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain jannati nahrein mushk ke pahadon se nikalti hain. Is mein pani ke alawa doodh ki nahrein bhi hain jin ka maza kabhi nahin badalta, bahut safed, bahut meetha aur nihayat saaf shaffaf aur ba-maza pur-zaiqa. Ek marfu' hadith mein hai ke yeh doodh janwaron ke than se nahin nikla hua balkay qudrati hai. Aur nahrein hongi sharab-e-saaf ki jo peene wale ka dil khush kar dein, dimagh kushada karein. Jo sharab na to badbudar hai, na talkhi wali hai, na bad-manzar hai. Balkay dekhne mein bahut achi, peene mein bahut lazeez, nihayat khushbudar, jis se na aql mein futoor aaye, na dimagh chakrayein, na munh se badbu aaye, na bak-jhak lage, na sar mein dard ho, na chakkar aayein, na behkein, na bhatkein, na nasha chadhe, na aql jaye. Hadith mein hai ke yeh sharab bhi kisi ke hathon ki kashidgi hui nahin balkay Allah ke hukum se tayyar hui hai. Khush-zaiqa aur khush-rang hai. Jannat mein shehad ki nahrein bhi hain jo bahut saaf hai aur khushbudar aur zaiqe ka to kehna hi kya hai. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai ke yeh shehad bhi makkhiyon ke pet se nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek marfu' hadith mein hai ke jannat mein doodh, pani, shehad aur sharab ke samundar hain jin mein se un ki nahrein aur chashme jaari hote hain. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi Shareef mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Sahih farmate hain. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai yeh nahrein Jannat-e-Adan se nikalti hain, phir ek hauz mein aati hain, wahan se bazariya aur nehron ke tamam jannaton mein jaati hain. Ek aur sahih hadith mein hai jab tum Allah se sawal karo to Jannat-ul-Firdaus talab karo, woh sab se behtar aur sab se a'la jannat hai, isi se jannat ki nahrein jaari hoti hain aur us ke upar Rahman ka Arsh hai. Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Laqit bin Aamir (R.A) jab wafd mein aaye the, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke jannat mein kya kuch hai?

Aap ne farmaya saaf shehad ki nehrein aur baghair nashe ke sar dard na karne wali sharab ki nehrein aur na bigadne wale doodh ki nehrein aur kharab na hone wale shaffaf paani ki nehrein aur tarah tarah ke mewa jaat ajeeb-o-ghareeb bemisal aur bilkul taaza aur paak saaf biwiyan jo saliheen ko milengi aur khud bhi salihaat hongi duniya ki lazzaton ki tarah un se lazzatein uthayenge haan wahan baal bachay na honge. Hazrat Anas R.A farmate hain yeh na khayal karna ke jannat ki nehrein bhi duniya ki nehron ki tarah khudi hui zameen mein aur garhon mein behti hain nahin nahin qasam Allah ki woh saaf zameen par yaksaan jaari hain un ke kinare kinare lulu aur motiyon ke khaime hain un ki mitti mushk-e-khalis hai phir farmata hai wahan un ke liye har tarah ke meway aur phal phool hain. Jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Yad'oona feeha bikulli fakihatin aamineen) (Surah Ad-Dukhan: 55), yani wahan nihayat aman-o-aman ke sath woh har qisam ke meway mangwayenge aur khayenge ek aur aayat mein hai (Feehima min kulli fakihatin zaujan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 52), dono jannaton mein har ek qisam ke mewaon ke joray hain un tamam naimaton ke sath yeh kitni bari naimat hai ke Rabb khush hai woh apni maghfirat un ke liye halal kar chuka hai. Unhein nawaz chuka hai aur un se raazi ho chuka hai ab koi kathka hi nahin. Jannaton ki yeh dhoom dhaam aur naimaton ke bayan ke baad farmata hai ke dusri janib jahannumiyon ki yeh halat hai ke woh jahannum ke darkaat mein jal bhulas rahe hain aur wahan se chutkaray ki koi sabeel nahin aur sakht pyaas ke mauqa par woh kholta hua garam paani jo darasal aag hi hai lekin ba-shakl-e-paani unhein peene ke liye milta hai ke ek ghont andar jatay hi aantain kat jaati hain Allah hamein panah mein rakhay. Phir bhala is ka is ka kya mail? Kahan jannati kahan jahannumi kahan naimat kahan zahmat yeh dono kaise barabar ho sakte hain.

Be-waqoof, kund-zehan aur jahil munafiqon ki kund-zehni aur be-ilmi, na-samjhi aur be-waqoofi ka bayan ho raha hai ke bawajood majlis mein shareek hone ke, Kalam-ur-Rasool sun lene ke, paas baithe hone ke, un ki samajh mein kuch nahin aata. Majlis ke khatmay ke baad Ahl-e-Ilm Sahaba (R.A) se poochte hain ke is waqt kya kya kaha? Yeh hain jin ke dilon par mohar Allah ne laga di hai aur apne nafs ki khwahish ke peeche par gaye hain, fahm-e-sareeh aur qasd-e-saheeh hai hi nahin. Phir Allah Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai jo log hidayat ka qasd karte hain unhein khud Allah bhi taufeeq deta hai aur hidayat naseeb farmata hai, phir us par jam jaane ki himmat bhi ata farmata hai aur un ki hidayat barhata rehta hai aur unhein rushd-o-hidayat ilham farmata rehta hai. Phir farmata hai ke yeh to isi intezar mein hain ke achanak Qayamat qaim ho jaye. To yeh maloom kar lein ke us ke qareeb ke nishanat to zahir ho chuke hain, jaise aur mauqa par irshad hua hai ayat (ھٰذَا نَذِيْرٌ مِّنَ النُّذُرِ الْاُوْلٰى) (Surah An-Najm: 56) yeh daranay wala hai aglay daranay walon se, qareeb aanay wali qareeb aa chuki hai. Aur bhi irshad hota hai ayat (اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ) (Surah Al-Qamar: 1), Qayamat qareeb ho gayi aur chand phat gaya aur farmaya ayat (اِقْتَرَبَ للنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيْ غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 1) logon ka hisab qareeb aa gaya phir bhi woh ghaflat mein munh moray hue hain. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka Nabi ho kar duniya mein aana Qayamat ki nishaniyon mein se ek nishani hai, is liye ke Rasoolon ke khatam karne wale hain, Aap (ﷺ) ke sath Allah Ta'ala ne apne deen ko kamil kiya aur apni hujjat apni makhlooq par poori ki aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Qayamat ki shartein aur us ki alamatein is tarah bayan farma dein ke Aap (ﷺ) se pehle kisi Nabi ne is qadar wazahat nahin ki thi, jaise ke apni jagah woh sab bayan hui hain. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ) ka aana Qayamat ki sharton mein se hai, chunancha khud Aap ke naam hadith mein yeh aaye hain: Nabi-ut-Taubah, Nabi-ul-Malhama, Hashir jis ke qadmon par log jama kiye jayen, Aaqib jis ke baad koi Nabi na ho. Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apni beech ki ungli aur us ke paas wali ungli ko utha kar farmaya main aur Qayamat misl in dono ke bheje gaye hain. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke kafiron ko Qayamat qaim ho jaane ke baad nasihat-o-ibrat kya sood-mand hogi? Jaise irshad hai ayat (يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّتَذَكَّرُ الْاِنْسَانُ وَاَنّٰى لَهُ الذِّكْرٰى) (Surah Al-Fajr: 23) us din insan nasihat hasil kar le ga lekin us ke liye nasihat kahan? Yani Qayamat ke din ki ibrat be-sood hai. Aur ayat mein hai ayat (وَّقَالُوْٓا اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ ۚ وَاَنّٰى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِنْ مَّكَانٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ) (Surah Saba: 52) yani us waqt kahenge ke hum Quran par iman laye halankeh ab unhein aise door-az-imkan par dastaras kahan ho sakti hai?

Ya'ni un ka iman us waqt be-sud hai phir farmata hai ae Nabi jaan lo ke Allah hi ma'bud-e-barhaq hai koi aur nahin, yeh darasal khabar dena hai apni wahdaniyat ka yeh toh ho nahin sakta ke Allah us ke ilm ka hukum deta ho. Isi liye is par atf daal kar farmaya apne gunahon ka aur momin mard-o-aurat ke gunahon ka istighfar karo. Sahih hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain (Allahummaghfirli khati'ati wa jahli wa israfi fi amri wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni, Allahummaghfirli jiddi wa hazli wa khata'i wa 'amdi wa kullu dhalika 'indi) ya'ni ae Allah meri khataon ko aur meri jahalat ko aur mere kamon mein mujh se jo ziyadati ho gayi ho us ko aur har cheez ko jise tu mujh se bahut ziyada janne wala hai bakhsh. Ae Allah mere be-qasd gunahon ko aur mere azm se kiye hue gunahon ko aur meri khataon aur mere qasd ko bakhsh aur yeh tamam mere paas hai. Aur sahih hadith mein hai ke aap apni namaz ke aakhir mein kehte (Allahummaghfirli ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu wa ma asraftu wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni, anta ilahi la ilaha illa anta) ya'ni ae Allah main ne jo kuch gunah pehle kiye hain aur jo kuch peeche kiye hain aur jo chhupa kar kiye hain aur jo zahir kiye hain aur jo ziyadati ki hai aur jinhein tu mujh se ziyada janta hai bakhsh de, tu hi mera Allah hai tere siwa koi ma'bud nahin. Aur sahih hadith mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ae logo apne Rab ki taraf tauba karo pas tahqeeq main apne Rab ki taraf istighfar karta hoon aur us ki taraf tauba karta hoon har ek din sattar baar se bhi ziyada. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Sarjas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya aur main ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khane mein se khana khaya phir main ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah aap ko bakhshe. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aur tujhe bhi, toh main ne kaha kya main aap ke liye istighfar karun? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan aur apne liye bhi, phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat padhi apne gunahon aur momin mardon aur ba-iman aurton ke gunahon ki bakhshish talab kar. Phir main ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dahne kandhe ya baayin hatheli ko dekha wahan kuch jagah ubhri hui thi jis par goya til the. Ise Muslim, Tirmidhi, Nasai waghera ne bhi riwayat kiya hai. Abu Ya'la mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum La ilaha illallah ka aur Astaghfirullah ka kehna lazim pakdo aur inhe bakasrat kaha karo is liye ke Iblees kehta main ne logon ko gunahon se halak kiya aur unhon ne mujhe in dono kalmon se halak kiya. Main ne jab yeh dekha toh inhe khwahishon ke peeche laga diya pas woh samajhte hain ke hum hidayat par hain. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka Nabi ho kar duniya mein aana Qayamat ki nishaniyon mein se ek nishani hai, is liye ke Rasoolon ke khatam karne wale hain, Aap (ﷺ) ke sath Allah Ta'ala ne apne deen ko kamil kiya aur apni hujjat apni makhlooq par poori ki aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Qayamat ki shartein aur us ki alamatein is tarah bayan farma dein ke Aap (ﷺ) se pehle kisi Nabi ne is qadar wazahat nahin ki thi, jaise ke apni jagah woh sab bayan hui hain. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ) ka aana Qayamat ki sharton mein se hai, chunancha khud Aap ke naam hadith mein yeh aaye hain: Nabi-ut-Taubah, Nabi-ul-Malhama, Hashir jis ke qadmon par log jama kiye jayen, Aaqib jis ke baad koi Nabi na ho. Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apni beech ki ungli aur us ke paas wali ungli ko utha kar farmaya main aur Qayamat misl in dono ke bheje gaye hain. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke kafiron ko Qayamat qaim ho jaane ke baad nasihat-o-ibrat kya sood-mand hogi? Jaise irshad hai ayat (يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّتَذَكَّرُ الْاِنْسَانُ وَاَنّٰى لَهُ الذِّكْرٰى) (Surah Al-Fajr: 23) us din insan nasihat hasil kar le ga lekin us ke liye nasihat kahan? Yani Qayamat ke din ki ibrat be-sood hai. Aur ayat mein hai ayat (وَّقَالُوْٓا اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ ۚ وَاَنّٰى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِنْ مَّكَانٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ) (Surah Saba: 52) yani us waqt kahenge ke hum Quran par iman laye halankeh ab unhein aise door-az-imkan par dastaras kahan ho sakti hai?

Ya'ni un ka iman us waqt be-sud hai phir farmata hai ae Nabi jaan lo ke Allah hi ma'bud-e-barhaq hai koi aur nahin, yeh darasal khabar dena hai apni wahdaniyat ka yeh toh ho nahin sakta ke Allah us ke ilm ka hukum deta ho. Isi liye is par atf daal kar farmaya apne gunahon ka aur momin mard-o-aurat ke gunahon ka istighfar karo. Sahih hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain (Allahummaghfirli khati'ati wa jahli wa israfi fi amri wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni, Allahummaghfirli jiddi wa hazli wa khata'i wa 'amdi wa kullu dhalika 'indi) ya'ni ae Allah meri khataon ko aur meri jahalat ko aur mere kamon mein mujh se jo ziyadati ho gayi ho us ko aur har cheez ko jise tu mujh se bahut ziyada janne wala hai bakhsh. Ae Allah mere be-qasd gunahon ko aur mere azm se kiye hue gunahon ko aur meri khataon aur mere qasd ko bakhsh aur yeh tamam mere paas hai. Aur sahih hadith mein hai ke aap apni namaz ke aakhir mein kehte (Allahummaghfirli ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu wa ma asraftu wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni, anta ilahi la ilaha illa anta) ya'ni ae Allah main ne jo kuch gunah pehle kiye hain aur jo kuch peeche kiye hain aur jo chhupa kar kiye hain aur jo zahir kiye hain aur jo ziyadati ki hai aur jinhein tu mujh se ziyada janta hai bakhsh de, tu hi mera Allah hai tere siwa koi ma'bud nahin. Aur sahih hadith mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ae logo apne Rab ki taraf tauba karo pas tahqeeq main apne Rab ki taraf istighfar karta hoon aur us ki taraf tauba karta hoon har ek din sattar baar se bhi ziyada. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Sarjas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya aur main ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khane mein se khana khaya phir main ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah aap ko bakhshe. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aur tujhe bhi, toh main ne kaha kya main aap ke liye istighfar karun? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan aur apne liye bhi, phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat padhi apne gunahon aur momin mardon aur ba-iman aurton ke gunahon ki bakhshish talab kar. Phir main ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dahne kandhe ya baayin hatheli ko dekha wahan kuch jagah ubhri hui thi jis par goya til the. Ise Muslim, Tirmidhi, Nasai waghera ne bhi riwayat kiya hai. Abu Ya'la mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum La ilaha illallah ka aur Astaghfirullah ka kehna lazim pakdo aur inhe bakasrat kaha karo is liye ke Iblees kehta main ne logon ko gunahon se halak kiya aur unhon ne mujhe in dono kalmon se halak kiya. Main ne jab yeh dekha toh inhe khwahishon ke peeche laga diya pas woh samajhte hain ke hum hidayat par hain. Ek aur asar mein hai ke Iblees ne kaha Allah mujhe teri izzat aur tere jalal ki qasam jab tak kisi shakhs ki rooh us ke jism mein hai main use behkata rahunga, pas Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya mujhe bhi qasam hai apni buzurgi aur badai ki ke main bhi inhe bakhshta hi rahunga jab tak woh mujh se istighfar karte rahein. Istighfar ki fazilat mein aur bhi bahut si hadithein hain.

Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke tumhara din mein her-pher aur tasarruf karna aur tumhara raat ko jagah pakadna Allah Ta'ala jaanta hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (WA HUWAL-LAZII YATAWAFFFAAKUM BIL-LAILI WA YA'LAMU MAA JARAH-TUM BIN-NAHAARI THUMMA YAB'ATHUKUM FIIHI LIYUQDAA AJALUM-MUSAMMAN, THUMMA ILAIHI MARJI'UKUM THUMMA YUNABBI'UKUM BIMAA KUNTUM TA'MALUUN) (Surah Al-An'am: 60), yani Allah woh hai jo tumhein raat ko faut kar deta hai aur din mein jo kuch tum karte ho woh jaanta hai. Ek aur aayat mein Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ka farman hai aayat (WA MAA MIN DAABBATIN FIL-ARDHI ILLAA 'ALALLAAHI RIZQUHAA WA YA'LAMU MUSTAQARRAHAA WA MUSTAWDA'AHAA, KULLUN FII KITAABIM-MUBIIN) (Surah Hud: 6), yani zameen par jitne bhi chalne wale hain un sab ki rozi Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai aur woh un ke rehne ki jagah aur dafan hone ka maqam jaanta hai, yeh sab baatein wazeh kitab mein likhi hui hain. Ibn-e-Jurayj ka yahi qaul hai aur Imam Jarir bhi isi ko pasand karte hain. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke murad aakhirat ka thikana hai. Suddi farmate hain tumhara chalna phirna duniya mein aur tumhari qabron ki jagah use maloom hai, lekin awwal qaul hi awla aur zyada zahir hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Iman ki daleel hukm-e-jihad ki tameel hai. Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke momin toh jihad ke hukm ki tamanna karte hain, phir jab Allah Ta'ala jihad ko farz kar deta hai aur is ka hukm nazil farma deta hai toh is se aksar log hat jate hain, jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Alam tara ilallazina qeela lahum kuffu aidiyakum wa aqimus-salata wa atuz-zakah) (Surah An-Nisa: 77) yani kya tu ne unhein nahin dekha jin logon se kaha gaya ke tum apne hathon ko rok lo aur namaz qaim rakho aur zakat ada karte raho, phir jab un par jihad farz kiya gaya toh un mein se ek fareeq logon se is tarah darne laga jaise Allah ka dar ho balkeh is se bhi zyada. Aur kehne lage ae hamare Rab hum par tu ne jihad kyun farz kar diya, tu ne hum ko qareeb ki muddat tak dheel kyun na di? Tu keh ke duniya ki mata' bahut hi kam hai aur parhezgaron ke liye aakhirat bahut hi behtar hai aur tum par bilkul zara sa bhi zulm na kiya jaye ga. Pas yahan bhi farmata hai ke iman wale toh jihad ke hukmon ki aayaton ke nazil hone ki tamanna karte hain lekin munafiq log jab un aayaton ko sunte hain toh ba-wajah apni ghabrahat, bokhlahat aur namardi ke aankhein phaad phaad kar is tarah tujhe dekhne lagte hain jaise maut ki ghashi wala. Phir unhein mard-e-maidan banne ki raghbat dilate hue farmata hai ke un ke haq mein behtar toh yeh hota ke yeh sunte mante aur jab mauqa aa jata ma'arka-e-karzar garm hota toh nek niyati ke sath jihad kar ke apne khuloos ka suboot dete. Phir farmaya qareeb hai ke tum jihad se ruk jao aur is se bachne lago toh zameen mein fasad karne lago aur sila-rehmi todne lago yani zamana-e-jahiliyat mein jo halat tumhari thi wahi tum mein laut aaye. Pas farmaya aise logon par Allah ki phitkar hai aur yeh Rab ki taraf se behre andhe hain. Is mein zameen mein fasad karne ki umooman aur qata-rehmi ki khusoosan muman'at hai. Balkeh Allah Ta'ala ne zameen mein islah aur sila-rehmi karne ki hidayat ki hai aur un ka hukm farmaya hai, sila-rehmi ke ma'ani hain qarabat-daron se baat-cheet mein, kaam-kaaj mein, sulook-o-ehsan karna aur un ki maali mushkilat mein un ke kaam aana. Is bare mein bahut si sahih aur hasan hadeesein marwi hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq ko paida kar chuka toh raham khada hua aur Rahman se chimat gaya, is se poocha gaya kya baat hai? Us ne kaha yeh maqam hai tootne se teri panah mein aane ka, is par Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya kya tu is se raazi nahin? Ke tere milane wale ko main milaun aur tere katne wale ko main kaat dun? Us ne kaha han is par main bahut khush hun. Is hadees ko bayan farma kar phir rawi-e-hadees Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne farmaya agar tum chaho toh yeh aayat padh lo (Fahal asaitum in tawallaitum an tufsidu fil-ardi wa tuqatti'u arhamakum) (Surah Muhammad: 22), aur sanad se hai ke khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya.

Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah waghaira mein hai koi gunah itna bada aur itna bura nahin jis ki bahut jaldi saza duniya mein aur phir us ki burai aakhirat mein bahut buri pahunchti ho ba-nisbat sarkashi, baghawat aur qata-rehmi ke. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs chahe ke us ki umr badi ho aur rozi kushada, woh sila-rehmi kare. Aur hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mere nazdiki qarabat-dar mujh se talluq todte rehte hain aur main unhein maaf karta rehta hoon, woh mujh par zulm karte hain aur main un ke sath ehsan karta hoon aur woh mere sath buraiyan karte rehte hain to kya main un se badla na loon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya nahin, agar aisa karoge to tum sab ke sab chhod diye jaoge, to sila-rehmi par hi reh aur yaad rakh ke jab tak tu is par baqi rahega Allah ki taraf se tere sath har waqt muawanat karne wala rahega. Bukhari waghaira mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya sila-rehmi Arsh ke sath latki hui hai, haqiqatan sila-rehmi karne wala woh nahin jo kisi ehsan ke badle ehsan kare balkay sahih ma'ani mein rishte-naate milane wala woh hai ke go tu use kaat-ta jaye woh tujh se jodta jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke sila-rehmi Qayamat ke din rakhi jayegi, us ki raanein hon misl hiran ki raano ke, woh bahut saaf aur tez zaban se bolegi, pas woh kaat diya jayega jo use kaat-ta tha aur woh milaya jayega jo use milata tha. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai reham karne walon par Rahman bhi reham karta hai. Tum zameen walon par reham karo, aasmanon wala tum par reham karega. Reham Rahman ki taraf se hai, us ke milane wale ko Allah milata hai aur us ke todne wale ko Allah Ta'ala khud tod deta hai. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf (R.A) ki bimar-pursi ke liye log gaye to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmane lage tum ne sila-rehmi ki hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya hai main Rahman hoon aur reham ka naam main ne apne naam par rakha hai, ise jodne wale ko main jodunga aur us ke todne wale ko main tod doonga aur hadith mein hai Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain roohein mili-juli hain jo roz-e-azal mein mel kar chuki hain woh yahan yaganat barat-ti hain aur jin mein wahan nafrat rahi hai yahan bhi doori rehti hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab zabani da'we badh jayen, amli kaam ghat jayen, zabani mel-jol ho, dili bughz-o-adawat ho, rishte-dar rishte-dar se bad-suluki kare us waqt aise logon par la'nat-e-Allah nazil hoti hai aur un ke kaan behre aur aankhein andhi kar di jati hain. Is bare mein aur bhi bahut si hadeesein hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ki tilawat farma rahe the ek naujawan Yamani ne kaha balkeh un par un ke qufl hain jab tak Allah na khole aur alag na kare pas Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke dil mein yeh baat rahi yahan tak ke apni khilafat ke zamane mein is se madad lete rahe. Phir farmata hai jo log hidayat zahir ho chukne ke baad imaan se alag ho gaye aur kufr ki taraf laut gaye darasal Shaitan ne is kaar-e-bad ko un ki nigahon mein achha dikha diya hai aur unhein dhoke mein daal rakha hai. Darasal un ka yeh kufr saza hai un ke is nifaq ki jo un ke dil mein tha jis ki wajah se woh zahir ke khilaf apna batin rakhte the. Kafiron se mil jul kar unhein apna karne ke liye un se batin mein batil par muwafiqat kar ke kehte the ghabrao nahin abhi abhi hum bhi ba'az umoor par tumhara sath denge lekin yeh baatein is Allah se to chhup nahin saktin jo androoni aur bairooni halaat se yaksar aur yaksan waqif ho jo raaton ke waqt ki posheeda aur raaz ki baatein bhi sunta ho jis ke ilm ki inteha na ho. Phir farmata hai un ka kya haal hoga? Jabke farishte un ki roohein qabz karne ko aayenge aur un ki roohein jismon mein chhupti phiren gi aur Malaika jabran, qahran, daant, jhirak aur maar peet se unhein bahar nikalenge. Jaise irshad-e-Bari hai aayat (Walao tara iz yatawaffallazina kafarul malaikatu yadzribuna wujuhahum wa adbarahum wazuqu azabal hariq) (Surah Al-Anfal: 50), ya'ni kaash ke tu dekhta jabke in kafiron ki roohein farishte qabz karte hue un ke munh par tamanche aur un ki peeth par mukke marte hain. Yahan un ka gunah bayan kiya gaya ke in kamon aur baton ke peeche lage hue the jin se Allah na-khush ho aur Allah ki raza se karahat karte the. Pas un ke a'maal akaarat ho gaye.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ki tilawat farma rahe the ek naujawan Yamani ne kaha balkeh un par un ke qufl hain jab tak Allah na khole aur alag na kare pas Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke dil mein yeh baat rahi yahan tak ke apni khilafat ke zamane mein is se madad lete rahe. Phir farmata hai jo log hidayat zahir ho chukne ke baad imaan se alag ho gaye aur kufr ki taraf laut gaye darasal Shaitan ne is kaar-e-bad ko un ki nigahon mein achha dikha diya hai aur unhein dhoke mein daal rakha hai. Darasal un ka yeh kufr saza hai un ke is nifaq ki jo un ke dil mein tha jis ki wajah se woh zahir ke khilaf apna batin rakhte the. Kafiron se mil jul kar unhein apna karne ke liye un se batin mein batil par muwafiqat kar ke kehte the ghabrao nahin abhi abhi hum bhi ba'az umoor par tumhara sath denge lekin yeh baatein is Allah se to chhup nahin saktin jo androoni aur bairooni halaat se yaksar aur yaksan waqif ho jo raaton ke waqt ki posheeda aur raaz ki baatein bhi sunta ho jis ke ilm ki inteha na ho. Phir farmata hai un ka kya haal hoga? Jabke farishte un ki roohein qabz karne ko aayenge aur un ki roohein jismon mein chhupti phiren gi aur Malaika jabran, qahran, daant, jhirak aur maar peet se unhein bahar nikalenge. Jaise irshad-e-Bari hai aayat (Walao tara iz yatawaffallazina kafarul malaikatu yadzribuna wujuhahum wa adbarahum wazuqu azabal hariq) (Surah Al-Anfal: 50), ya'ni kaash ke tu dekhta jabke in kafiron ki roohein farishte qabz karte hue un ke munh par tamanche aur un ki peeth par mukke marte hain. Aur aayat mein hai (Walao tara iziz-zalimuna) al-kh, ya'ni kaash ke tu dekhta jabke yeh zalim sakrat-e-maut mein hote hain aur farishte apne hath un ki taraf maarne ke liye phailaye hue hote hain aur kehte hain apni jaanein nikalo aaj tumhein zillat ke azab kiye jayenge is liye ke tum Allah ke zimme na-haq kaha karte the aur us ki aayaton mein takabbur karte the. Yahan un ka gunah bayan kiya gaya ke in kamon aur baton ke peeche lage hue the jin se Allah na-khush ho aur Allah ki raza se karahat karte the. Pas un ke a'maal akaarat ho gaye.

Munafiq ko us ke chehre ki zaban se pehchano yani kya munafiqon ka khayal hai ke un ki makkari aur ayyari ka izhar Allah musalmanon par kare ga hi nahin? Yeh bilkul ghalat khayal hai Allah Ta'ala un ka makr is tarah wazeh kar de ga ke har aqalmand unhein pehchan le aur un ki bad-batni se bach sake. Un ke bohat se ahwal Surah Bara'ah mein bayan kiye gaye aur un ke nifaq ki bohat si khaslaton ka zikr wahan kiya gaya. Yahan tak ke is surat ka dusra naam hi Fazihah rakh diya gaya yani munafiqon ko fazihat karne wali. (Adhghan) jama hai (Zighn) ki, Zighn kehte hain dili hasad-o-bughz ko. Is ke baad Allah Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai ke ae Nabi agar hum chahein to un ke wajood tumhein dikha dein pas tum unhein khulam khulla jaan jao. Lekin Allah Ta'ala ne aisa nahin kiya un tamam munafiqon ko bata nahin diya taake us ki makhlooq par parda para rahe un ke uyub poshidah rahein, aur batni hisab isi zahir-o-batin janne wale ke hath rahe lekin haan tum un ki batchit ke tarz aur kalam ke dhang se hi unhein pehchan lo ge. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) farmate hain jo shakhs kisi poshidgi ko chupata hai Allah Ta'ala use us ke chehre par aur us ki zaban par zahir kar deta hai. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jo shakhs kisi raaz ko parda mein rakhta hai Allah Ta'ala use us par ayan kar deta hai woh behtar hai to aur badtar hai to. Hum ne Sharh-e-Sahih Bukhari ke shuru mein amli aur aitqadi nifaq ka bayan puri tarah kar diya hai jis ke dohrane ki yahan zaroorat nahin. Hadith mein munafiqon ki ek jamaat ki (ta'yeen) aa chuki hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai "Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ek khutbe mein Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya tum mein ba'az log munafiq hain pas jis ka main naam loon woh khara ho jaye. Ae falan khara ho ja, yahan tak ke chhatis ashkhas ke naam liye. Phir farmaya "tum mein" ya "tum mein se" munafiq hain, pas Allah se daro. Is ke baad un logon mein se ek ke samne Hazrat Umar (R.A) guzre woh us waqt kapre mein apna munh lapete hue tha. Aap use khoob jante the pucha ke kya hai? Us ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki upar wali hadith bayan ki to aap ne farmaya Allah tujhe gharat kare. Phir farmaya hai hum hukm-e-ahkam de kar rok tok kar ke tumhein khud azma kar maloom kar lein ge ke tum mein se mujahid kaun hain? Aur sabr karne wale kaun hain? Aur hum tumhare ahwal azmayein ge. Yeh to har musalman janta hai ke zahir hone se pehle hi us Allam-ul-Ghuyub ko har cheez, har shakhs aur us ke a'maal maloom hain to yahan matlab yeh hai ke duniya ke samne khol de aur is haal ko dekh le aur dikha de isi liye Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is jaise mawaqe par (Lana'lama) ke ma'ani karte the (Linariya) yani taake hum dekh lein.

Nekiyon ko gharat karne wali buraiyon ki nishandahi: Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke kufr karne wale, rah-e-Allah ki bandish karne wale, Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat karne wale, hidayat ke hote hue gumrah hone wale Allah ka toh kuch nahin bigadte, balkeh apna hi kuch khote hain. Roz-e-Qayamat wale din yeh khali hath honge, ek neki bhi in ke paas na hogi. Jis tarah nekiyan gunahon ko mita deti hain, isi tarah is ke badtareen jurm-o-gunah in ki nekiyan barbad kar denge. Imam Muhammad bin Nasr Marwazi (R.H) apni kitab 'As-Salah' mein hadith laye hain ke Sahaba ka khayal tha ke (La ilaha illallah) ke sath koi gunah nuqsan nahin deta, jaise ke shirk ke sath koi neki nafa nahin deti. Is par Ashab-e-Rasool is se darne lage ke gunah nekiyon ko batil na kar dein. Dusri sanad se marwi hai ke Sahaba-e-Kiram ka khayal tha ke har neki bil-yaqeen maqbool hai, yahan tak ke yeh ayat utri toh kehne lage ke hamare a'amal barbad karne wali cheez kabira gunah aur badkariyan karne wale par inhein khauf rehta tha aur in se bachne wale ke liye umeed rehti thi. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala apne ba-iman bandon ko apni aur apne Nabi ki ita'at ka hukum deta hai jo in ke liye duniya aur akhirat ki sa'adat ki cheez hai aur murtad hone se rok raha hai jo a'amal ko gharat karne wali cheez hai. Phir farmata hai Allah se kufr karne wale, rah-e-Allah se rokne wale aur kufr hi mein marne wale Allah ki bakhshish se mehroom hain. Jaise farman hai ke Allah shirk ko nahin bakhshta. Is ke baad Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu farmata hai ke aye mere momin bando! Tum dushmanon ke muqable mein aajizi ka izhar na karo aur in se dab kar sulh ki dawat na do, halankeh quwwat-o-taqat mein, zor-o-ghalba mein, ta'dad-o-asbab mein tum qawi ho. Haan jabkeh kafir quwwat mein, ta'dad mein, asbab mein tum se zyada hon aur Musalmanon ka Imam maslahat sulh mein hi dekhe toh aise waqt beshak sulh ki taraf jhukna jaiz hai, jaise ke khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hudaibiya ke mauqe par kiya, jabkeh mushrikeen-e-Makkah ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Makkah jane se roka toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne das saal tak ladai band rakhne aur sulh qaim rakhne par mu'ahida kar liya. Phir iman walon ko bahut badi basharat-o-khushkhabri sunata hai ke Allah tumhare sath hai, is wajah se nusrat-o-fatah tumhari hi hai. Tum yaqeen mano ke tumhari choti se choti neki bhi woh zaya na karega balkeh is ka pura pura ajar-o-sawab tumhein inayat farmaye ga. Wallahu A'alam.

Haan jabkeh kafir quwwat mein, ta'dad mein, asbab mein tum se zyada hon aur Musalmanon ka Imam maslahat sulh mein hi dekhe toh aise waqt beshak sulh ki taraf jhukna jaiz hai, jaise ke khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hudaibiya ke mauqe par kiya, jabkeh mushrikeen-e-Makkah ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Makkah jane se roka toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne das saal tak ladai band rakhne aur sulh qaim rakhne par mu'ahida kar liya. Phir iman walon ko bahut badi basharat-o-khushkhabri sunata hai ke Allah tumhare sath hai, is wajah se nusrat-o-fatah tumhari hi hai. Tum yaqeen mano ke tumhari choti se choti neki bhi woh zaya na karega balkeh is ka pura pura ajar-o-sawab tumhein inayat farmaye ga. Wallahu A'alam.

Sakhawat ke faide aur bukhal ke nuqsanat duniya ki haqarat aur is ki qillat-o-zillat bayan ho rahi hai ke is se siwaye khel tamashe ke aur kuch hasil nahin, han jo kaam Allah ke liye kiye jayen woh baqi reh jate hain. Phir farmata hai ke Allah ki zaat be-parwah hai, tumhare bhale kaam tumhare hi nafa ke liye hain, woh tumhare malon ka bhooka nahin. Us ne tumhein jo khairat ka hukum diya hai woh sirf is liye ke tumhare hi ghurba, fuqra ki parwarish ho aur phir tum daar-e-akhirat mein mustahiq-e-sawab bano. Phir insaan ke bukhal aur bukhal ke baad dili kine ke zahir hone ka haal bayan farmaya. Maal ke nikalne mein yeh toh hota hi hai ke maal insaan ko mehboob hota hai aur is ka nikalna is par garan guzarta hai. Phir bakhilon ki bakhili ke wabaal ka zikr ho raha hai ke fi sabilillah kharch karne se maal ko rokna darasal apna hi nuqsan karna hai kyunke bakhili ka wabaal isi par parega. Sadqe ki fazilat aur is ke ajar se mehroom bhi rahega. Allah sab se ghani hai aur sab us ke dar ke bhikari hain. Ghina Allah Ta'ala ka wasf-e-lazim hai aur ehtiyaaj makhlooq ka wasf-e-lazim hai. Na yeh is se kabhi alag hon na woh is se. Phir farmata hai agar tum is ki ita'at se rogardaan ho gaye, is ki shariyat ki tabedari chhor di toh woh tumhare badle tumhare siwa aur qoum layega jo tum jaisi na hogi, balkeh woh sunne aur manne wale hukum-bardar, nafarmaniyon se bezar honge. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim aur Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne jab yeh aayat tilawat farmayi toh sahaba ne poocha ke huzoor (ﷺ) woh kaun log hain jo hamare badle laye jate aur hum jaise na hote? Toh aap (ﷺ) ne apna haath Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) ke shane par rakh kar farmaya yeh aur in ki qoum, agar deen surayya ke paas bhi hota toh ise Fars ke log le aate. Is ke ek raawi Muslim bin Khalid Zanji ke bare mein ba'az aimma-e-jarh-o-ta'deel ne kuch kalaam kiya hai, wallahu a'alam. Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Qitaal ki tafseer khatam hui.
